position_revisions.why: The frame still holds: which intake and pantry arrangements take effect together on the November start, and what rule each runs by. Priya's 1 October statement set a fortnightly rota with a fifteen-minute overlap call. src-1 keeps the fortnightly cadence but replaces the overlap length with thirty minutes, so the fifteen-minute statement is no longer correct. src-2 gives the reason for the change, that fifteen minutes covered the open cases but not those arriving during the hand-off week. The pantry rule (_2) and the shared start date (_3) are untouched.
